thread:
Ben: Quick heads-up — we have a deploy quiet window scheduled tomorrow 09:00-12:00 UTC for the exec all-hands + planned infra DB maintenance. No non-emergency releases during the window. Exceptions need sign-off from release leads + infra oncall.

Ben: Please do the following before EOD today: run dependency compatibility checks, pause scheduled canaries that land in the window, and avoid any schema migrations without explicit infra approval. If you have a rollout in progress, aim to finish or rollback by 08:30 UTC. Link to checklist: https://internal.redwood/ops/deploy-checklist :eyes:

deploy-bot: Auto-canary suppression will be enabled at 08:45 UTC. Autoscaling controls will be temporarily disabled 09:00-11:30 UTC. This is an automated notice.

Jules: Ack. My embeddings-model canary was slated for 10:00 — I'll postpone to 13:00. :thumbsup:

Deepa: Quick question — if we need a hotfix that must ship in the window, what's the exception path?

Ben: @Deepa — open a thread in #release-exceptions, ping me and @infra-oncall, include PR link, risk summary, and your rollback plan. Also attach results from `./scripts/compat-check.sh`. We'll triage within 30m of the request.

Priya: Ran the compat check against the pytorch bump — failing on CUDA kernel shape mismatch. Log snippet:

```
Compatibility check: pytorch-2.1 -> 2.2
ERROR: aten::conv2d forward shape mismatch at step 3
Suggested action: pin to 2.1 until infra resolves kernel change
```

Priya: Putting the failing PR on hold and notifying the model team.

Marcus: I'll take the kernel issue. Opening an infra ticket and will try a rollback patch. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4823 — I've set a canary hold.

Carla: Reminder to folks — Customer Success needs a heads-up if any rollout might affect tail-latency or quotas. Please add CS to your rollout notes.

Ben: Good call. I'll add CS and send a short exec note about the maintenance window. Anyone planning to request an exception, please do that by 20:00 UTC today so we can review.

deploy-bot: Quiet window active at 09:00 UTC. Canary suppression and autoscaling controls are in effect. Will post when controls lift.

Ben: Thanks all — please comment here with any high-risk rollouts so we can coordinate.
